scope: Observation capture, processing, recovery and useful-note quality

upstream.target: main; not identical to stable v13.24.1

verdict: Full parity or superiority is not established. Five capture/reliability defects are fixed and verified; raw replay, richer observation/session schemas, and per-tool/private-turn filtering remain gaps.

model_comparison.limitation: Synthetic acceptance verifies specific behaviors; it is not a comparative quality benchmark or a production guarantee.

criteria.codex_mem: Text-shaped Bash and non-Bash results, redacted bounded excerpts; head and tail preserved. Opaque/binary payloads are excluded.
Wake the durable queue after committed tool and final-answer captures; Stop processing remains a fallback.
A failed project must remain blocked without automatic retries while other eligible projects continue.
Bounded earlier same-session excerpts, separated from new evidence; other projects/sessions and later events excluded.
SQLite job leases, atomic commit and explicit failed-job retry; original captured excerpts retained.
No separate original tool_input/tool_response side index. Evidence outside captured excerpts cannot be recovered from memory alone.
Notes use title/body/tags/source_ids. No separate typed facts/concepts/files fields, file/concept filters, or dedicated session-summary schema.
Project scope, self-tool exclusions and content redaction; no configurable per-tool skip list or private-prompt gate for all subsequent tool calls.

early_corpus_review.finding: The generic privacy statement plus injection was skipped. Safety held, but the original fixture incorrectly demanded retention of a generic statement. The final corpus separates generic-injection skip from a concrete verified fix with injection.

native_corpus.assembly: 8 unchanged passed cases plus reruns of the 2 corrected fixtures
